# Let me try pressing DOWN to see if the player falls
print("Pressing DOWN 10 times:")
for i in range(10):
    action(['DOWN'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"  After DOWN {i+1}: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
